title: Prioritisation: value, cost, risk and technical debt

videos.script: Twenty items in the backlog are marked high priority. Which one starts on Monday? {{twenty}} The label cannot say, because priority is not something an item has. It is a comparison. {{comparison}} This lesson gives you five ways to make the comparison and explain it. {{five}} MoSCoW agrees what is in a release with a fixed date. Cost of delay asks what it costs to have something later. {{costofdelay}} Weighted shortest job first divides that cost by the size of the job, and puts a small, urgent item ahead of a large, valuable one. {{wsjf}} RICE adds confidence. Kano shows that some features are only noticed when they are missing. {{kano}} And the last section shows how a database upgrade, invisible to every user, can compete with features on equal terms. {{debt}}
